description: Handle one GitHub issue for the inbox sweep. Classifies via issue_triage, then in live mode delivers: code_request → code_smith (judge loop, tested commit) + evidence comment; proposal → inbox_worker prototype + comment; anything else → "needs-human". dryRun=true classifies only — no writes. Returns category and result.

constraints.literal: Return only the JavaScript function, no explanations or markdown.

Prototype committed by the inbox sweep to `{path}`.

*Autonomous delivery with receipts — a human reviews before close.*
